argument_macro_structure.dominant_argument_form: Cumulative hierarchical argument with progressive refinement
argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: Moderately explicit; key premises are stated but some background assumptions remain implicit

argumentative_quality.dialectical_reasonableness: High; engages with the strongest version of the opposing view (tactile guarantee) and concedes its intuitive force before refuting it
argumentative_quality.logical_relevance: All sections directly serve the thesis; no digressions
argumentative_quality.premise_acceptability: Premises are generally plausible within contemporary epistemology; relies on widely accepted distinctions (Pollock's defeaters) and thought experiments (BIV, phantom limbs)

distinctions_drawn: Single-modality vs. compound perceptually justified beliefs

dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: Systematic; each section anticipates and addresses likely objections (e.g., the privileged status of touch, the strength of compound beliefs)
objections_raised: The intuition that touch provides unassailable guarantee of material existence
The intuition that compound beliefs are practically conclusive
The intuition that spherical vision's coherence makes it invulnerable

epistemic_stance_and_voice.certainty_language_frequency: Moderate; uses hedged terms like 'practically conclusive,' 'remarkably well,' 'astronomically lower'

appeals_to_authority: Aristotle and G.E. Moore (touch as fundamental sense)
method_and_evidence.evidence_type: Phenomenological description, thought experiments, empirical examples (phantom limbs, tactile hallucinations), conceptual analysis

philosophical_orientation.grounding: Empiricism with fallibilist orientation; draws on phenomenology and epistemology of perception
philosophical_orientation.sentiment: Anti-foundationalist regarding empirical certainty; pro-hierarchical regarding epistemic robustness
philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: Epistemology of perception, defeasibility theory, skepticism

structural_organization.structure_type: Five-part progressive argument: (1) framework, (2) single-modality visual, (3) compound perceptual, (4) tactile challenge, (5) synthesis into hierarchy

summary_of_core_decisions: The essay systematically dismantles conclusive empirical indefeasibility by showing that each level of perceptual justification, while progressively more robust, remains vulnerable to some class of defeaters. It culminates in a four-level hierarchy of defeasibility grounded in informational richness and cross-modal integration.

thesis_commitment.conclusion_type: Qualified rejection of the target thesis; acceptance of a graded alternative
thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: High; uses terms like 'practically conclusive,' 'not absolute,' 'apex of empirical justification'
